ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is an acyl fragment, shown as R-C(=O)-O-, in which the carbonyl carbon is connected to R, a double-bonded oxygen, and a single-bonded oxygen; this single-bonded oxygen is connected to the central carbon on the right side. The central carbon forms a double bond with the N-R3 above, and forms a single bond with the adjacent carbon on the right side. The adjacent carbon on the right side is also connected to R2, and is connected to an N(H)-R1 fragment. The curved arrows and dashed arrows in the figure are ignored according to the problem statement, and only the atom connectivity relationship is retained. Reasoning: After ignoring the arrows, the overall connectivity graph can be written as R-C(=O)-O-C(=N-R3)-C(R2)-N(H)-R1. As required, replace R, R1, R2, and R3 all with the SMILES wildcard *. Starting from the imine nitrogen substituent side, write it as */N=C; the acyloxy branch on the imine carbon is written in parentheses as /OC(*)=O; then continue to the adjacent carbon substituted with the R2 wildcard and amino wildcard, written as C(*)N*. Combining gives */N=C(/OC(*)=O)C(*)N*.

raw_record.question_text: Please choose the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows. <image_1>

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a connectivity graph without arrows: R-C(=O)-O-C(=N-R3)-C(R2)-N(H)-R1. Replace each R substituent R, R1, R2, and R3 by the SMILES wildcard '*'. Start from the imine nitrogen substituent side as */N=C, put the acyloxy substituent on the imine carbon in parentheses as /OC(*)=O, then continue to the adjacent carbon bearing wildcard R2 and amino wildcard substituent as C(*)N*. The resulting SMILES expression is */N=C(/OC(*)=O)C(*)N*.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个酰基片段，显示为 R-C(=O)-O-，其中羰基碳连接 R、双键氧以及单键氧；这个单键氧连接到右侧的中心碳。中心碳与上方的 N-R3 形成双键，并与右侧相邻碳形成单键。右侧相邻碳还连接 R2，并连接一个 N(H)-R1 片段。图中的弯箭头和虚线箭头按题意忽略，只保留原子连接关系。推理：忽略箭头后，整体连接图可写作 R-C(=O)-O-C(=N-R3)-C(R2)-N(H)-R1。按要求把 R、R1、R2、R3 都替换为 SMILES 通配符 *。从亚胺氮取代基一侧开始写为 */N=C；亚胺碳上的酰氧基支链写在括号中为 /OC(*)=O；然后继续到相邻的带 R2 通配符和氨基通配符取代的碳，写为 C(*)N*。合并得到 */N=C(/OC(*)=O)C(*)N*。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the skeletal structure: a left acyl carbonyl R-C(=O)-O- attached through oxygen to an imidate-like carbon; that central carbon is double-bonded to N-R3 and single-bonded to a chiral/unspecified carbon bearing R2 and N(H)-R1. Ignore all curved electron-flow arrows and lone-pair markings.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the task is to choose/write the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and that the arrows in the image must be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent generic R groups as wildcard atoms '*'; encode C=N with N substituent using N=C(...); encode the ester fragment as OC(*)=O; represent the amino substituent as N*; use slash stereochemical bond markers as in the provided transition-state drawing/answer format, yielding the canonical option-compatible string.
